notes.title: Patch 1.14: The community patch
notes.content:
Together with the Wings of Vi community, a lot of quality of life changes and fixes have been made - along with a new modifier: the mirror mode. This'll flip the screen horizontally, but also flip your controls. This means, that the world will be backwards but you'll still control as normal.

Just wanted to use this time to say thanks to all the support the game has gotten over the years - and is still getting. It meant that I could do game development fulltime, at least for now, and it's been the best time in my life. I'm still working on Roah, which is still slated for late 2017 - early 2018 (But it's done when it's done).

Changelog:
- Added a new modifier: Mirrored.
- Ira found her halo in the heart of the baneful.
- Inconsistency with fluttering and jumping fixed.
- Camera will now scroll properly when off-screen in the Azurel boss fight.
- Fireguys/charrers/materializers can't be hit while invisible and becomes vulnerable more quickly after teleporting.
- The Staff of Purity now correctly starts with all purity orbs stored.
- Several enemies no longer trigger the melee attack, since they are immune.
- Can now get back from secret places in the Floating Keep.
- Flame cracks in the underworld should no longer incorrectly time their animations.
- Electram no longer glows after enrage.
- Pr'gora no longer shows more damage taken than what Vi has dished out.
- Vi no longer leaves behind her stuff as she goes into the portal to the Floating Keep.
- The spikes in Jeh'Oul's face goes away when he dies.
- Electram doesn't move horizontally when he dies.
- Several cutscenes are now skippable.
- Wolves no longer rarely and randomly turn invisible.
- Score screen now correctly retrieves your fastest time.
- Skipping the darkheim watch cutscene doesn't trigger the menu anymore.
- That one spider in the spider grove doesn't despawn anymore and will fight alongside his brethren once again.
- Ancient Spike Construct's enraged middle laser attack will now start on the opposite side of Vi.
- Centaurs in the Underworld will now properly spawn when reaching multiple of them after not dying.
- Levers in the Chambers will now properly reset when respawning with the Life Orb.
- Brutes will now properly reset when respawning with the Life Orb.
- The fire from the death of rock trolls will now always deal damage.
- The mouse cursor should now be hidden at all times.
- Loading times on Windows 10 should be better.

Updated later on:
- Myougi no longer deals contact damage on demon mode difficulty.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
General:

[list]
[*]Overall performance increase.
[*]The chests requiring a specific difficulty setting no longer counts towards the completion percentage for a game save. This makes it possible to get 100% on all difficulties, not just demon.
[*]Darkheim Watch dialogue should explain the mechanic a bit better.
[*]Added option to turn the ingame controller support off.
[/list]

Areas:
[list]
[*]The Floating Keep: Reworked the obstacle course for a more organic experience.
[*]Sinister Grotto: Removed a mine that would hit the player based on a specific timing that was not intended.
[*]Path of Decay: Amethyst's planet doesn't need her any longer after the first cutscene.
[/list]

Bosses:
[list]
[*]Amethyst: Fire duration is now extended during wind and death phases.
[*]Dark Annihilator: Laser effect improved to collide with the ground like other lasers.
[*]Ancient Constructs: Two constructs being activated on the same frame should no longer cause them to freak out.
[*]Azurel: Red shield lasts longer.
[*]Azurel: Minor health increase.
[*]Azurel: Souls are now more noticeable.
[*]Azurel: Found her tail after all this time.
[/list]

*
Azurel softlock on death (sometimes) fix.
Crazy smoke fix.
*
Fire trail effect during Amethyst fix.
Achievements count for getting 100% on a file again.
Fixed vale fruit spawn.
*
Regular NPC dialogue is now skippable.
*
Skipping chest opening animations now shows the item above the players head for a brief moment.
"Picky" achievement for the Ancient Constructs fix.
*
Jeh'Oul wouldn't start after dialogue while time travelling.
Siniter grotto laser part after minecart made a bit less precise. It was more about the puzzle, rather than precision.
Fixed an issue with brutes spawning multiple times on the elevator segment in hellspawn.
Fixed an issue with secret chests being picked up twice.
Fixed an issue with multiple achievements not being queued correctly when resetting.
*
The timer always starts at the same place when starting a new game instead of 0-1 second.
Can dialogue skip darkheim characters that give you items and still get the items.
Hellspawn: stones in underworld key area despawn when hit.
*
Minor sinister grotto changes.

notes.title: Patch 1.07 is Released
notes.content:
This is primarily a bug-fixing and balance patch. There's more coming in the future but this is the first wave.

[b]**Please back up your saves. There is a post about this on the forums**[/b]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changes have been made to how you swap weapons. When you hold the button the menu opens, then you use up and down to cycle through them.
[*]Fixed a small but that would cause Vi to not attack in certain situations.
[/list]
[*]Ira's [spoiler]jiggle[/spoiler] has been nerfed.
[/list]

[h1]Terrestrial Vale[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Electram's horizontal lightning attack should have more time between shots on Demon Mode.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The timing on Amethysts' Ice Shard and Rocks have been tweaked slightly on Demon Mode.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Sinister Grotto[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Fixed a few areas that would instantly kill you, even with the Life Orb.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Dark Annihilator will now give a small notification of where 'Repair Missiles' are coming from.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Underworld[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Ancient Construct should no longer continue to attack after you die.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Ancient Construct should now take less damage from individual statues being damage, but will take slightly more damage when enrages are triggered.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Ancient Construct's right statue has had it's enrage changed.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Acropolis of Anguish[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Meteors' have a longer cast time.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Meteors' should stand out against the background better.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Fire Portals' now have a smaller "tail."[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Fire Shield' should no longer block shots during her enrage.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Stalking Flame' now lasts significantly longer.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II's 'Stalking Flame' will now collide with meteors, decreasing it's size. If it becomes small enough it will dissipate entirely.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II has a new move in her arsenal.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Myougi II can only have one set of 'Meteors' active at a time.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Azurel[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]You can now mutate during Azurel's fight.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel will no longer deal contact damage.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's life has been increased slightly.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel should start shifting platforms earlier.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's 'Wild souls' will spawn more consistently now.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's 'Shadow Storm' has had it's cooldown increased significantly, but now adds multiple stacks. (Angel - 1, Mortal - 2, Demon - 3)[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's arena is no longer as dark.[/spoiler]

[/list]

[h1]Heart of the Baneful[/h1]

notes.content:
[b]**Please back up your saves. There is a post about this on the forums**[/b]

This is primarily a frame-rate fixing patch. Every area in the game has been broken up into multiple portions. When you load into your save, you should be teleported to the correct "frame" based on where you saved. [b]If for any reason when you load into your save, you are in the incorrect area or are "falling" outside of the map, please post on the forums.[/b] We've checked most areas but some may have slipped past.

In addition if there are any issues with missing art assets [b]please report them to the forums[/b]. When moving objects to a new frame some of them might not have been copied over properly.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Modifiers should now work properly.
[*]Almost all areas in the game have been broken up into multiple frames, which should boost framerates by ~30-40% for most players, if not more.
[*]The lowest settings should now have even higher framerates, but look slightly worse. (No smoke, limited glows, etc)
[*]The menu should no longer show for 1 frame at the start of each new area.
[*]Saving is now triggered on events, so there should be fewer Darkheim watch issues.
[*]Hellspawn mode should be working properly now. If you find any traps or hazards that instantly kill you, please report them as bugs.
[*]Orbs of purity have their hitboxes made smaller, and should now travel straighter.
[*][spoiler]Two new cosmetics are in the game[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Floating Keep: Aftermath[/h1]

[*][spoiler]Wolves had had their hitbox made bigger to make up for Orb's smaller hitbox.[/spoiler]

[/list]

[*][spoiler]Fixed a bug where J2 was not spawning worms properly.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]J2 will now give an item when beaten flawlessly, this item is still a WIP[/spoiler]
[/list]

1.07 will be a bug fixing and balance patch, with some changes coming to the later game to make the jump in difficulty at [spoiler]AoA[/spoiler]  less intimidating.

notes.content:
[b]**Please back up your saves. There is a post about this on the forums**[/b]

This is primarily a balance and bug-fix patch, but will also convert your global setting and option to a new format. Should you experience any form of issues with the new format, please make a post on the forums. This shouldn't affect your saves at all.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]The main source of corruption was through a compression extension. We have removed all forms of it, both in saves and global variables. When you load up game your saves should convert to an uncompressed format. As a result, saves should no longer corrupt nearly as often, even during crashes or BSOD. It never hurts to back up your saves just in case, as always
[*]Screen shakes have been reduced in multiple events.
[/list]

[h1]Terrestrial Vale[/h1]
[list]
[*][spoiler]The background islands in Terrestrial Vale should now move properly.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Modified a jump in Terrestrial Vale that was too difficult.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Underworld[/h1]

[*][spoiler]Laser bug on Ancient Constructs should be fixed.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Acropolis of Anguish[/h1]

[*][spoiler]You can now get back from the Corrupted Weapon chest.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Twin Orcs should now trigger an enrage every two volleys instead of three.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The shield enrage of Twin Orcs should no longer bug out on Demon Mode.[/spoiler][*][spoiler]The shield enrage has been made shorter.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Twin Orcs have had their HP reduced slightly.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Path of Decay[/h1]

[*][spoiler]You should no longer be placed outside of the map if you backtrack into AoA.[/spoiler]

[*][spoiler]You should now save properly even if you don't skip Azurel's cutscene.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's new attacks will now trigger earlier.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The priority and frequency of Azurel's attacks have been modified.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Azurel's HP has been moderately increased.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]When you defeat Azurel her effects should now disappear properly.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Heart of the Baneful[/h1]

notes.content:
A hotfix has been put out that should fix the majority of issues introducted with converting saves in the original patch 1.04.

For those who would like to know what happened, an extension that looked at your computer's name (was left over from leaderboards) interfered with the new save system and would, for some people, delete in-game achivements or cosmetics. This extension didn't do anything in the current game, and has no purpose anymore so it's been removed and this issue should no longer occur.

If you backed up your save, you can use the backups and the data should still be fine. If you did not, you may be able to use a system restore point to get your old saves back. Because the data is deleted, we cannot restore it.

If you can prove some of the cosmetics you had through steam pictures or achivements previous to the patch I can restore these on a case-by-case basis, but there is no global patch we can put out for this.

We're incredibly sorry for anyone this might have effected, and will try to fix and problems this may have caused.


If you are still experiencing problems please post on the steam forums.


EDIT: There was another issue with the game flashing your save information for a second then going back to the menu, this should be fixed too.
